ABOUT.TITLE: About
ABOUT.BIO_P1: I'm Larry, an independent software engineer in Tours, France. By day I build logistics systems for a large international group; the rest of the time I run Atom Studios, a solo studio: about thirty projects, including two SaaS products in production.
ABOUT.BIO_P2: Everything is self-hosted: GitLab, CI, a Kubernetes cluster, AI models. Three machines, zero cloud — my users' data never leaves the infrastructure. Stack: Python (FastAPI), Angular, PostgreSQL, k3s, Flux GitOps.
ABOUT.BIO_P3: My conviction: platform-team rigor is within reach of a single person, provided machines do the repeatable work — self-verifying deployments with automatic rollback, backups proven by real restores, end-to-end tests every night. I apply the same standards to the websites I ship for small businesses.
